newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - JGBs seen firm, but Nomura news may hurt.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - JGBs seen firm, but Nomura news may hurt.

text.p: Key June 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures are likely to rise toward a technical resistance point of 124.50 on Wednesday after Tuesday's rally.
Traders said the 124.50 level would represent a 38.2 percent recovery of the recent fall to a low recorded last week of 122.70 from the all-time high of 127.34 recorded on April 8.
But the Ministry of Finance's (MOF) announcement late on Tuesday that it was suspending Nomura Securities Co Ltd from JGB auctions and bond underwriting may overshadow the market, traders said.
